tools.name: school_signals_search
tools.description: Free. Find buyer ids (school:<URN>, trust:<UID>, org:<slug>) with counts of published edtech contracts, renewals in the next 12 months, live tenders and trust changes. Use before school_buyer_brief.

tools.name: school_renewals
tools.description: Paid $0.03 USDC. Up to 25 published edtech contracts at English schools, trusts and councils ending in a window, with incumbent, value, extensions, estimated re-procurement window and official notice links. Empty results and invalid filters are refused before payment.

tools.name: school_buyer_brief
tools.description: Paid $0.20 USDC. Hierarchy, published edtech contracts and incumbents, upcoming renewals with estimated windows, live tenders, recent trust changes and official links for one buyer. Unknown, ambiguous (candidates returned) or evidence-free buyers are refused before payment.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Free. Every product with its price in USDC, route, licence and how to pay (x402 or plain transfer on Base).

tools.name: buy_file_x402
tools.description: Paid 295 USDC (school-signals-england-snapshot) or 149 USDC (dfe-ai-safety-toolkit) via x402; returns a signed 48-hour download link, the file SHA-256 and an order URL. Without payment returns the x402 terms. If your client caps automatic payments, use create_transfer_order instead.

tools.name: create_transfer_order
tools.description: Free. Creates a 24-hour order with an order-specific exact USDC amount on Base. Send exactly that amount of canonical USDC to the recipient in one transfer, then call check_transfer_order with the transaction hash.

tools.name: check_transfer_order
tools.description: Free. With only order: status (and a fresh download link once paid). With tx_hash: verifies the Base transaction (canonical USDC, recipient, exact amount, success, time window, 10 confirmations, never used before) and returns the download link.
